Roth.exists_hasseDeriv_index_eval_bound_aux✝.{u_1} {σ : Type u_1} [Fintype σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {r : σ → ℕ}
  {α z : σ → ℝ} {C γ c : ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (hd : ∀ (j : σ), degreeOf j P ≤ r j)
  (hbound : ∀ (i k : σ →₀ ℕ), |(eval α) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) ((hasseDeriv i) ((hasseDeriv k) P)))| < C)
  (hγ : γ ≤ Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) P) α r) (hz : Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) P) z r < c) :
  ∃ Q,
    Q ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ (j : σ), degreeOf j Q ≤ r j) ∧
        γ - c < Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) Q) α r ∧
          (eval z) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) Q) ≠ 0 ∧
            ∀ (i : σ →₀ ℕ), |(eval α) ((hasseDeriv i) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) Q))| < C

private theorem Roth.exists_hasseDeriv_index_eval_bound_aux.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ]
  {P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {r : σ → ℕ} {α z : σ → ℝ} {C γ c : ℝ},
  P ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (j : σ), degreeOf j P ≤ r j) →
      (∀ (i k : σ →₀ ℕ), |(eval α) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) ((hasseDeriv i) ((hasseDeriv k) P)))| < C) →
        γ ≤ Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) P) α r →
          Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) P) z r < c →
            ∃ Q,
              Q ≠ 0 ∧
                (∀ (j : σ), degreeOf j Q ≤ r j) ∧
                  γ - c < Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) Q) α r ∧
                    (eval z) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) Q) ≠ 0 ∧
                      ∀ (i : σ →₀ ℕ), |(eval α) ((hasseDeriv i) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) Q))| < C :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {P} {r} {α z} {C γ c} hP hd hbound hγ hz ↦
  Exists.casesOn
    (Roth.exists_hasseDeriv_eval_ne_zero
      ((map_ne_zero_iff (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) (map_injective (Int.castRingHom ℝ) Int.cast_injective)).mpr hP) z r
      hz)
    fun k h ↦
    And.casesOn h fun hkw hkev ↦
      have hQev :=
        Eq.mpr (id (congrFun' (congrArg Ne (eval_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) z ((hasseDeriv k) P))) 0))
          (Eq.mp
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Ne
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (⇑(eval z)) (hasseDeriv_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) k P))
                  (eval_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) z ((hasseDeriv k) P))))
              0)
            hkev);
      Exists.intro ((hasseDeriv k) P)
        ⟨fun h0 ↦
          hQev
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (eval z) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) _a) = 0) h0))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (eval z) _a = 0) (map_zero (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)))))
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = 0) (map_zero (eval z)))) (Eq.refl 0)))),
          ⟨fun j ↦ LE.le.trans (degreeOf_hasseDeriv_le j k P) (hd j),
            ⟨Eq.mpr
                (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ γ - c < Roth.index _a α r) (Eq.symm (hasseDeriv_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) k P))))
                (LT.lt.trans_le (LT.lt.trans_le (sub_lt_sub_left hkw γ) (sub_le_sub_right hγ (Roth.weight r k)))
                  (Roth.index_sub_weight_le_index_hasseDeriv
                    (fun h0 ↦
                      hkev
                        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (eval z) _a = 0) h0))
                          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = 0) (map_zero (eval z)))) (Eq.refl 0))))
                    α r)),
              ⟨hQev, fun i ↦
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg LT.lt
                        (congrArg abs
                          (Eq.trans (congrArg (⇑(eval α)) (hasseDeriv_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) i ((hasseDeriv k) P)))
                            (eval_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) α ((hasseDeriv i) ((hasseDeriv k) P))))))
                      C))
                  (Eq.mp
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg LT.lt
                        (congrArg abs (eval_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) α ((hasseDeriv i) ((hasseDeriv k) P)))))
                      C)
                    (hbound i k))⟩⟩⟩⟩

MAINLEMMA_PRIVATE256_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {r : σ → ℕ} {α z : σ → ℝ}
  {C γ c : ℝ},
  P ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (j : σ), degreeOf j P ≤ r j) →
      (∀ (i k : σ →₀ ℕ), |(eval α) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) ((hasseDeriv i) ((hasseDeriv k) P)))| < C) →
        γ ≤ Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) P) α r →
          Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) P) z r < c →
            ∃ (Q : MvPolynomial σ ℤ),
              Q ≠ 0 ∧
                (∀ (j : σ), degreeOf j Q ≤ r j) ∧
                  γ - c < Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) Q) α r ∧
                    (eval z) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) Q) ≠ 0 ∧
                      ∀ (i : σ →₀ ℕ), |(eval α) ((hasseDeriv i) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) Q))| < C
